scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope&&scope.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const at=(o,p)=>{if(o==null||!p)return undefined;if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o,p))return o[p];return p.split('.').reduce((c,k)=>{if(c==null)return undefined;if(/^\d+$/.test(k)&&Array.isArray(c))return c[Number(k)];return c[k];},o);};const read=(...ps)=>{for(const p of ps){const v=at(root,p);if(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&String(v).trim()!=='')return v;}return '';};const esc=(v)=>String(v==null?'':v).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');const one=(v)=>String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();return one(read('alert_group_id','alert_group.id','alert_group.public_primary_key','id'));

conditions.description: The incoming webhook must carry an alert identifier, otherwise nothing can be deduplicated.

actions.name: Create Jira Incident from Grafana OnCall Alert
actions.description: Create a Jira incident for a firing Grafana OnCall alert that has no open linked incident.

flowVariables.name: issueKey
flowVariables.instruction: Jira incident key created for the Grafana OnCall alert.

conditions.description: Only create when no open incident is already linked to this alert.
Never open a Jira incident from a resolve or recovery event.

actions.name: Comment Existing Jira Incident
actions.description: Add an internal comment when Grafana OnCall re-notifies for an alert that already has an open Jira incident.

conditions.description: Only comment when an open linked Jira incident already exists.

actions.name: Link Grafana OnCall Alert on Jira Incident
actions.description: Add a Jira remote link back to the Grafana OnCall alert.

conditions.description: Only create a remote link when the payload carried an alert URL.

actions.name: Transition Jira Incident on Alert Resolve
actions.description: Transition the linked Jira incident when Grafana OnCall reports the alert resolved. Disabled until a transition ID is set.

conditions.description: Only transition an incident that already exists.
Only transition on a resolve or recovery event.
Skip entirely until the customer sets a transition ID for their workflow.
